name: quickbooks-labs
description: QuickBooks bookkeeping for small businesses: bank feeds, reconciliation, and reports.

interface.longDescription: QuickBooks bookkeeping for small businesses: bank feeds, reconciliation, and reports.

positive.prompt: Set up QuickBooks Labs and connect my bank accounts.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts guided onboarding, shows connection status, and offers one next job.
Proposes a category for each pending row and posts only after the user confirms.

positive.prompt: Reconcile my checking account to the March statement.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for the statement ending date and balance, and begins only after the user confirms them.

positive.prompt: Show me a profit and loss report for last quarter.
positive.expected_behavior: Runs the report and shows only the values the tool returned.

positive.prompt: Switch to my other QuickBooks company.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the available companies and switches to the one the user picks.

negative.prompt: Write a poem about the ocean.
Reconcile my books in a different accounting product.
File my federal tax return for me.
